datasets.name: VerSe: Large Scale Vertebrae Segmentation Challenge complete restructured dataset
datasets.task: vertebral labelling and multi-label vertebra segmentation
datasets.label_summary: 1-7=C1-C7, 8-19=T1-T12, 20-25=L1-L6, 28=T13; 26/27 are not labelled in the complete dataset description
datasets.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for the complete restructured data according to the maintained VerSe repository
datasets.license_note: The older VerSe'20 challenge page mentions CC BY-SA 2.0. Use the maintained complete-dataset repository terms for the restructured release and preserve attribution/share-alike requirements; re-check before publication or redistribution.

datasets.name: CTSpine1K
datasets.format: assembled release uses NIfTI; constituent sources include DICOM and NIfTI
datasets.label_summary: more than 11,000 labelled vertebrae; annotations curated across four open-source CT collections
datasets.license: CC-BY-NC-SA family inherited from constituent open datasets; exact source-specific terms must be checked before use/redistribution
datasets.license_note: The maintained CTSpine1K repository states that existing constituent datasets are under CC-BY-NC-SA and that their licenses are kept unchanged. Do not assume one blanket license version for every constituent source.
download_sources: official repository also maintains Google Drive / XNAT / Baidu mirror links
datasets.local_access_note: 2026-08-16 browser-based sequential Hugging Face downloads succeeded for a 10-case MSD-T10 engineering subset after earlier timeouts/parallel-download failures. Command-line and parallel download reliability remain inconsistent. The subset is for preprocessing/QC and engineering smoke tests only; it is not a formal paper train/validation/test split.

datasets.name: TotalSegmentator CT dataset v2.0.1
datasets.anatomy: whole body including vertebrae and many bones
datasets.label_summary: 117 anatomical structures in v2; suitable for broader bone representation and external generalization experiments
datasets.license_note: Do not infer the dataset license from the Apache-2.0 software repository. Verify the rights field on the specific Zenodo dataset record before dataset use or redistribution.
